verdict.rationale: GrowthBook publishes a tiered pricing page (Starter/Pro/Enterprise-like tiers) listing feature gates (visual editor, approval workflows, SSO/SCIM, etc.) and calls out unlimited flags/experiments/traffic and per-user caps like 'Up to 3 users', but none of the evidence shows usage-based cost drivers like MAUs, events, or API requests being priced or metered — the plans appear seat/feature-gated rather than usage-metered. missing for 10: explicit cost drivers tied to MAUs/events/requests, a pricing calculator or usage-based cost breakdown, and independent confirmation that published prices match real invoices.
